business_summary: Shijiazhuang ChangShan BeiMing Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the textile, and software and IT services businesses in China and internationally. The company engages in the production and sale of pure cotton and blended yarns; import and export of self-produced products and technologies; and wholesale and retail of cotton. It offers software and information technology solutions, including software development and services; intelligent installation engineering; technology import and export; environmental protection technology development, consulting, exchange, and transfer; and information system integration services, as well as cloud computing; cloud data centers; consulting, implementation, operation, and maintenance services for smart cities; and online dispute resolution platform. In addition, the company offers computer application electronic equipment; and warehouse and logistics services, such as intelligent cold chain logistics and sorting centers. Further, it engages in the sale of communication electronic equipment parts and LCD monitors; information transmission; technical research and experimental development; technology promotion and application; real estate; and business services. The company was formerly known as Shijiazhuang Changshan Textile Company Limited and changed its name to Shijiazhuang ChangShan BeiMing Technology Co.,Ltd in October 2017. Shijiazhuang ChangShan BeiMing Technology Co.,Ltd was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Shijiazhuang, China.
